title: smtp_relay: parse_email_addrs splits on comma, breaks on quoted display names
description: reader/src/post/smtp_relay.rs:112 — splits address list on ',' then uses find('<')/rfind('>') to extract addresses. Fails on RFC 5322 addresses with commas in quoted display names (e.g. "Smith, John" <j@example.com>). mailparse::addrparse() is already a dep in this crate and handles this correctly. Fix: replace parse_email_addrs with mailparse::addrparse().
